description: Create a new game server on the account, optionally from a preset or with per-game options (see get_creation_options). Accepts human-readable names (game short name like "minecraft-java", software like "Paper"/"Velocity"/"Fabric", a version string) and resolves them; omit software/version for the recommended defaults. Subject to the same subscription, slot and RAM-pool checks as the panel: creation fails cleanly when the plan has no free slot.

game.description: Game short name, e.g. "minecraft-java" (default), "minecraft-bedrock", "rust", "palworld". Use exactly these slugs.

name.description: Display name for the server (3-100 chars, letters/numbers/spaces).

options.description: Per-game creation options keyed as get_creation_options lists them (e.g. {"onlineMode": false, "difficulty": "hard", "slots": 10}). Unknown keys or values are refused with the allowed values.

preset.description: A ready-made setup for the game, by key from get_creation_options (e.g. "friends", "any-launcher", "community", "hard" for Minecraft; "expert" for Terraria). Fills the options; any option given explicitly overrides it.

ram_mb.description: RAM in MB (min 1024). Default: 2048, capped by the account's free RAM pool at start time.

software.description: Server software name for Minecraft, e.g. Paper, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Velocity, Vanilla. Default: Paper.

version.description: Version string, e.g. "1.21.8". Default: the latest available for the chosen software.

name: create_server

message.description: What was created and what happens next.

title: Create Server
